services.desc: At Heritage Sylvania, the history you read about in textbooks becomes a vibrant learning experience full of activities for students. Our programs cover a wide variety of Ohio academic standards, including interdisciplinary curriculum. Subjects including Social Studies, Language Arts, Math, and Science are all incorporated into your visit. All programs integrate visits to our historic buildings and are designed to synchronize with strands from the Ohio proficiency tests, Achievement Assessments, and State of Ohio grade-specific standards. Students get the perfect mix of learning, adventure, and fun all in a scenic and safe environment where our dedicated staff and volunteers lead the way. We
